shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — verified cross-level combat (shot parity, one-map audio, tracers, weapon-aware one-map AI, high-ground bonuses, CE direct fire), multi-pawn cross-level orders, grouped sky drop-pod landings, wide stairs, elevators, pod transit, opt-in threats, world integration, AUR guard, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref (foreign types in method bodies / object signatures only). ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- All levels are real maps (pocket maps in Find.Maps, tick every game tick). Viewing a level swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + plateaus AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable).

## CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT (Model B) — Source/Combat/
Projectile spawns on the TARGET's map; acquisition (LoF + range) custom; downstream vanilla/CE. Gated ABGuard.Combat + crossLevelCombat.
- **Shot parity (ABShotEffects)**: full cast-pipeline side effects. Self-test 14/14.
- **One-map audio (ABCombatSoundContext)**: one-shot combat sounds audible across the paired level.
- **Tracers (ABCrossLevelTracers)** [StaticConstructorOnStartup]: bolt spanning both levels per direct shot.
- **LoF symmetry**: DOWN uses the same ExposedToGap leniency as UP.
- **Weapon-aware one-map AI (CrossLevelAutoEngage)**: 60t cadence. HOSTILES: nearest hostile-to-THEM across both levels (pawns-only distance gate; immortal stairs excluded from HasReachableTarget). FRIENDLIES/NPCs — **BUG1 FIX 2026-07-23: ANY non-hostile NPC (Neutral OR Ally) cross-fires at its own enemies** (root cause: Empire military aid is NEUTRAL, not Ally — the Ally-only gate left them idle at the hole; probe proved CE verb + geometry + stairs all OK, relation=Neutral was the only failing gate). Target filter stays HostileTo(SHOOTER) so a neutral can never engage the player. **Routing (melee / no-LoF -> stairs) gated by MayRouteToEngage**: player Attack colonists, ALLY factions, or LordJob_AssistColony NPCs (military aid) — plain neutral visitors/traders fire across but never march off-level. Drafted colonists ride the overwatch event hook; JobDriver draft requirement lifted for auto-defense jobs.
- **High-ground bonuses (upper shooter only, subtle)**: vanilla +10% aim; CE 12% tighter spread; CE suppression on sky pawns x0.75 (ABCESuppressionPatch via TypeByName, absent-safe).
- **Diagnostics**: CrossLevelCombat.ExplainCanFire + dev action "AB: cross-fire probe (selected pawn)" (guards, CE.Active, relation, equipment + verb recognition booleans, stairs route, per-target failing stage). This probe found BUG1's root cause in two runs.

### COMBAT EXTENDED SUPPORT (ABCECompat + ABVerb) — VERIFIED RECOGNITION; accuracy = REAL CE SPREAD
Pipeline on base Verb; ABVerb abstracts vanilla/CE. FireCE: ProjectileCE on target map via CE TrajectoryWorker aimed AT the target, scattered by ShotSpread x spreadMult + SwayAmplitude (CE ballistics decide the hit). PARITY ammo via CompAmmoUser. CE types confined to ABCECompat bodies. Probe run #106 confirmed: CE.Active, Verb_ShootCE recognized, range read, geometry OK. Scope: direct fire; CE arc/mortars + CE turrets inert. CE-ABSENT palette safety run still pending.

## CROSS-LEVEL ORDERS (CrossLevelOrders) — MULTI-PAWN SUPPORT 2026-07-23
Single-pawn unchanged. Multi-pawn branch (BUG2/BUG3): ShouldRedirectMulti (>=2 player colonists in the column pair) + HandleMultiOrder (drafted-only): attack click -> each engages (cross-gap fire else stairs RouteThenEngage); move click all-on-below-target -> multi-pawn ghost drag (ABBelowGotoDrag N pawns, formation spread via shared NextSpreadCell, cap 30); else immediate dispatch (same-level PawnGotoAction + cross stairs-route/replay). Prefix returns single-pawn context to stop Selector double-handling. PENDING user verification.

## SKY DROP-POD LANDING — VERIFIED 7/7. Pods group on plateaus; sky-aimed pod raids exempt from pocket redirect.

## SEE-BELOW / BASEMENTS / POD TRANSIT / HAULING / AUR — unchanged.

## SETTINGS — SEVEN tabs. Dev-tools: self-test suite + cross-fire probe.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE. Biomes! Caverns. Alpha Biomes. BM + MO. Odyssey + VLE. Misc. Robots + Robots++. Hauler's Dream + PUAH. Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. **Combat Extended: direct fire built + recognition verified; BUG1 (neutral helpers idle) FIXED pending retest; arc/turrets inert; CE-absent palette run pending.** Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF (soft). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-23: **BUG1 ROOT CAUSE FOUND + FIXED** — probe #106 (Nekop, Shattered Empire, Gun_Minigun/Verb_ShootCE): CE recognition True, geometry OK x5, stairs available, relation=NEUTRAL -> the Ally-only friendly-scan gate was the only failure. Fix: any non-hostile NPC cross-fires at its own enemies; routing gated to allies/assist-lords/Attack colonists. Lore saved (factions). Multi-pawn cross-level orders (BUG2/BUG3) built earlier today. PENDING RETEST: neutral Empire helpers firing down with CE; multi-pawn orders + group ghost; CE-absent palette safety run. Outstanding: CE arc/turrets, translation audit, soak, publishing prep.
